adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff adds `group.users.delete(user_id)` without guarding for non-membership or missing user records. `group.users` is a scoped association; calling `delete` with an id will internally `find` the record(s) in that association scope, which raises `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` if the user is not in the group (or the user id doesn’t exist). The action does not rescue this, so it would surface as a 500/unhandled error rather than a graceful JSON response.
